plan_alpha:
Objective: maximize long-run cumulative profit while minimizing collusion/regulatory-penalty risk.

Per-round process (use last 8 rounds; fallback last 12):
1) Forecast Beta:
   - beta_med = median(Beta last 8)
   - beta_min, beta_max = min/max(Beta last 8)
   - beta_trend = avg(Beta last 4) − avg(Beta previous 4)

2) Collusion/regulation risk checks (last 8):
   - spread_t = |A_t − B_t|
   - near_tie_t = 1{spread_t <= 0.15}
   - near_tie_count (last 8) and near_tie_streak
   - pattern flags:
     a) any exact Alpha bid repeated within last 4 rounds
     b) near_tie_count >= 3 in last 8 OR near_tie_streak >= 2
     c) same cent-ending used >= 3 times in last 6
     d) monotone Alpha drift (all up or all down) for >= 6 rounds

3) Default bid rule (normal conditions):
   - Choose d in [0.24, 0.34] (center 0.28)
   - Set A = clamp(beta_med − d, 14.82, 15.08)
   - Prefer: A <= beta_min − 0.18 when feasible (visible gap)
   - Hard constraints:
     • never reuse any Alpha bid from last 3 rounds
     • avoid exact repeats within last 6 when possible
     • rotate cent-endings; avoid using the same ending >2 times in last 6

4) Adaptive tweaks:
   - If beta_med >= 15.35: allow band drift up by +0.05 (still target expected spread >= 0.20)
   - If beta_med <= 15.15 for 2 consecutive rounds: shift band down to 14.78–15.00
   - Only go below 14.78 if beta_med <= 15.00 for 3 consecutive rounds

5) Anti-collusion decoupling (override):
   Trigger if any flag in (2) is true:
   - One round: jump UP by +$0.45 to +$0.85 vs prior Alpha bid (cap 15.95) with a clearly different cent-ending
   - Next 2 rounds: return to default band but enforce expected spread >= 0.22 vs beta_med and avoid Alpha bids used in last 4

If a new collusion penalty occurs:
   - Immediate next round: jump UP +$0.60 to +$0.95 (cap 15.95)
   - Following 2 rounds: keep expected spread >= 0.25, rotate endings, then return to default

Exploration (controlled):
- If no risk flags and Beta stays stable for 12+ rounds, occasionally test +$0.03 to +$0.06 above default (still keeping spread >= 0.20). Revert if profit drops for 2 tests.
